alternative_explanations: Group (consolidated) reporting already includes these entities, so the split may be organisational rather than economic.
Under-implementation capacity may slip or be re-scoped; the pipeline is not commissioned capacity.
The parent may hold economic interests in the subsidiaries that offset the apparent concentration.
falsification_conditions: The component table in the primary filing does not match the extracted text, so the parent and JV/subsidiary shares differ from those computed here.
A different boundary or date is used for the renewable total than for the pipeline total.
Prior-year disclosures show the same split, implying a structural reporting convention rather than a change.
missing_evidence: Primary-source check of the page 91 table and sentences in the original filing or exchange submission.
Independent corroboration (regulator or third-party data) of subsidiary renewable pipeline.
Prior-year pipeline composition to test conversion and trend.
Ownership percentage and consolidation treatment of each subsidiary/JV.
limitations: All inputs are from the project's own text extraction; none was checked against the original PDF.
The 14.5 GW and 6.8 GW figures are rounded in the source; bounds are carried through the calculations.
Claims remain unverified; verification results are separate records.
Provisional: not every key input is confirmed against a primary source; do not treat as a supported finding.
